channel.title: CVE Daily — AI Curated
channel.description: Today's curated vulnerabilities highlight a significant surge in remotely exploitable flaws across web applications, cloud infrastructure, and network equipment, with authentication bypasses and arbitrary code execution dominating the threat landscape. Critical weaknesses were identified in widely used platforms including WordPress and WooCommerce plugins, AWS Babelfish, Red Hat Keycloak, IBM API Connect, and Cisco networking gear, alongside numerous buffer overflow vulnerabilities in consumer and enterprise routers. These findings underscore persistent risks in third-party integrations, misconfigured access controls, and insufficient input validation that continue to enable unauthorized system access and data compromise across both IT and operational environments.

item.title: CVE-2026-83844 — Desktop OS
item.description: Allows local code execution via an out-of-bounds read in Windows Paint, a pre-installed utility frequently targeted by social engineering and malware droppers.

item.title: CVE-2023-5178 — Desktop OS
item.description: A kernel-level use-after-free in the NVMe/TCP subsystem can trigger remote code execution or information leakage, severely impacting host stability and security.

item.title: CVE-2023-4911 — Desktop OS
item.description: Actively exploited in the wild; malicious GLIBC_TUNABLES environment variables enable local privilege escalation via SUID binaries.

item.title: CVE-2023-39191 — Desktop OS
item.description: Lack of validation in eBPF dynamic pointers allows CAP_BPF users to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code.

item.title: CVE-2026-123832 — Desktop OS
item.description: JSON compilation database parsing flaw in CLion enables arbitrary code execution even in restricted safe mode.

item.title: CVE-2026-93523 — Desktop OS
item.description: Out-of-range modifier values in X.Org requests cause heap overflow, allowing authenticated clients to crash or execute code.

item.title: CVE-2023-43787 — Desktop OS
item.description: Integer overflow in libX11's XCreateImage function permits local execution of arbitrary code with elevated privileges.

item.title: CVE-2026-121386 — Desktop OS
item.description: Causes denial of service in FreeRDP clients when processing malformed clipboard images, disrupting remote desktop connectivity and endpoint availability.

item.title: CVE-2026-82159 — Desktop OS
item.description: Enables script injection via cross-site scripting in Dell Wyse Management Suite, potentially compromising thin client administration interfaces and corporate endpoint fleets.

item.title: CVE-2026-123966 — IoT Security

item.title: CVE-2026-124060 — IoT Security

item.title: CVE-2026-123963 — IoT Security

item.title: CVE-2026-123881 — IoT Security

item.title: CVE-2026-112354 — IoT Security

item.title: CVE-2026-105978 — IoT Security

item.title: CVE-2026-17403 — Cloud Security
